title: Flip Juice Salt-Nic E-Liquid – Kiberry Ice 30ml
description:
Description
Introducing Flip Juice, the latest line of salt nicotine e-liquids curated by Flip Bar, renowned for its exciting dual-flavour disposable vapes! Surrender to the irresistible allure of Kiberry Ice; tantalizing blend of tangy kiwi, and luscious mixed berries, all enlivened by a refreshing icy touch that captivates your taste buds with every puff.
Meticulously formulated with top-tier ingredients, Flip Juice is the ultimate choice for those seeking a smooth and satisfying vaping experience. Whether you’re a long-time vaper or just starting off, Flip Juice makes the perfect all-day vape that promises satisfaction.
Flip Juice Salt-Nic E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Flip Juice Salt-Nic E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
